summary: Build 18 pre-review frontend-only regression on preview (mobile viewport 375x667). Verified: (1) Full palette visual regression sweep across Home, /modes, /shop, /support, /settings, /account — no blank screens, no invisible/unreadable text, no overlapping layouts; new deep-navy base with gold PLAY, cyan/emerald/ruby chain-ball accents renders cleanly. (2) Owner diagnostics: signed in as ADMIN qa.owner.b15@vaultpop.test → /settings shows testID owner-diagnostics-card BELOW Admin Console button, containing exact lines 'Ads platform: unsupported (web/Android preview)', 'Ads initialized: NO', 'Consent status: not gathered yet', 'Can request ads: unknown', 'ATT status: not requested yet', 'Last ads error: none', 'Banner placements: no attempts yet', a STOREKIT header, and 'Store session not started yet.' — all owner-scoped, no PII. (3) Player negative: qa.player@vaultpop.app → /settings has NEITHER owner-diagnostics-card NOR settings-admin-console-button (correct gating). (4) Shop unchanged: hero shows MEMBER PICK + 'VaultPass Plus' + 'US$2.99 per month', disabled 'Currently Unavailable' button, caption 'VaultPass is unavailable right now. Please try again later.', functional testID shop-catalog-retry-button. Admin sees shop-vaultpass-diagnostics: 'Requested app.vaultpop.vaultpass.plus.monthly — The App Store is unavailable in Expo Go.' (new SKU string intact). (5) Core flows: player sign-in → status-pill SYNCED + account-signout-button; sign-out returns to sign-in form. Admin /account OWNER TOOLS → account-admin-console-button navigates in-app to /admin-console (URL updates, title 'Admin Console' present). Home home-play-button navigates to /gameplay?mode=classic (Vault Reactor board renders). Deprecated pointerEvents / textShadow* / useNativeDriver console warnings persist from iterations 6-8 (web-only, non-blocking).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — carry-over from iterations 6-8, non-blocking on web.
Console warning: '"textShadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "textShadow".' — non-blocking, RN 0.76+ deprecation.
Console warning: 'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported ... Falling back to JS-based animation.' — expected on web preview (no RCTAnimation module), native iOS build unaffected.

action_items: No functional fixes needed for Build 18 pre-review — every acceptance checkpoint (visual regression, owner diagnostics card + STOREKIT section, player negative gating, shop VaultPass hero + admin diagnostics with new SKU, admin console navigation, PLAY navigation) passed on preview.

(Carry-over, non-blocking) Migrate legacy `pointerEvents` prop → `style.pointerEvents`, and `textShadow*` props → unified `textShadow` shorthand to silence RN 0.76+ deprecation warnings across the app.

Backend testing intentionally skipped per review request (production TS backend Run Checks/diagnostics already deployed + verified by main agent; preview FastAPI mirror correctly does not implement /v1/admin/diagnostics).
critical_code_review_comments: owner-diagnostics-card.tsx: pure presentational component reading getAdsDiagnostics() + getStoreDiagnostics(); no tokens, receipts, or user PII surfaced — safe for owner-only display. useSyncExternalStore for ads is correct pattern for the diagnostics store.

settings-screen.tsx L108-119: role gate `profile.account.role === 'admin'` renders both Admin Console link and OwnerDiagnosticsCard together in the ACCOUNT section; card correctly appears BELOW the Admin Console ActionLink as required.

theme/colors.ts palette rewritten: background #050510 / surface #0A0F22 / gold #FFC93E / cyan #00E5FF / emerald #00F58C / violet #7C5CFF / ruby #FF2E86 — all high-contrast against F4F8FF text; verified readable across all 6 tested screens.
Preview session persistence: localStorage key 'vaultpop.saveProfile.v1' retains role between reloads; verified admin & player role gating consistent after cross-screen navigation.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (5/5 acceptance groups — visual regression, owner diag card + STOREKIT lines, player negative, shop unchanged incl. admin diagnostics SKU, core flows incl. Admin Console + PLAY navigation)
